summary_rationale: Macpower CNC Machines Limited is a debt-light (net cash ₹25.6 Cr as of Sep-2026), promoter-led (73.22% holding) domestic CNC machine-tool manufacturer delivering 27%–30% ROCE and structurally higher 16%+ operating margins via backward integration (40%–45% in-house component count) and mix premiumization (NEXA at 40% of the ₹476.7 Cr order book). However, it is classified as CYCLICAL_CONDITIONAL rather than a pure secular compounder because: (1) ~90% fixed non-material cost structure creates sharp operating deleverage during MSME capex downturns (FY20 sales -42%, OPM 6%); (2) high-mix manufacturing requires 259 inventory days (182-day CCC) and depressed FY26 pre-tax CFO/EBITDA conversion to 48% (though H1 FY27 OCF rebounded to ₹29.97 Cr); and (3) the 2,500-machine plant is at ~95% utilization—forcing 10–20 monthly order refunds—making on-time commissioning of the 13-acre plant by Q2 FY28 and recovery in the contracted government tender pipeline (₹1,942M) critical execution gates.
